messages:
Jamie: Heads up — Jordan says their POC hits are spiking and they see increasing 429s and occasional 504s during stress runs. Executive demo Friday 10:00am PT.
Jordan (Acme): We're running a ramp script that goes to 250 concurrent sessions over 20m. Errors: mostly 429 rate_limited, a few 504s. sample x-request-id: b7c9a1. No auth issues.
Lee: They are evaluating Dedicated 8x A10G. Pricing Q: can we give a short-term demo discount if we hit reliability milestone? Not blocking but good to know.
Maya: Please post the client request headers and the network traces. Also confirm if this is hosted or the Dedicated trial endpoint.
Jordan (Acme): Hosted us-east-1, model redwood-13b-std. Header snippet: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>`, `x-request-id: b7c9a1`, `Content-Type: application/json`. Sending logs to support now.
Maya: Got logs. We're seeing a sustained 429 response pattern from the edge with `retry_after` absent — looks like per-route throttling. Also a few 502s from backend model worker restarts.
Nate: Hypothesis: routing layer is rejecting bursts due to per-tenant concurrency cap. Also a few worker OOMs triggered by long max_tokens (they use 2048). Quick fixes: lower client concurrency to 60, reduce max_tokens to 1024 for demo, temporarily bump tenant concurrency for 3 hours.
Jordan (Acme): Lowering concurrency on our side now. What's the tenant bump procedure? We need confirmation + rollback plan.
Sam: I can apply a per-tenant concurrency override on the router: `tenant.acme.max_concurrency=400` for a 4h window. I'll only do this if eng-oncall approves.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-900 opened for acme-poc — severity P1. Pages sent.
Priya (eng-oncall): Approve for immediate override. Sam, go ahead. Nate, provide the rollback threshold and signals to auto-revert.
Nate: Rollback: if error_rate >2% for 10m or GPU mem >85% on serving pool, revert to defaults. I'll also schedule a canary with smaller batch kernel to reduce OOMs and enable worker verbose logs.
Maya: Applying client-side guidance to Jordan: set concurrency=60, max_tokens=1024, enable exponential backoff with jitter. We'll re-run synthetic suite in 10m.
Jordan (Acme): Updated client, running the 15m smoke now.
Sam: Override live. Monitoring dashboards show concurrency for acme pool increased, no immediate CPU/GPU spikes. p95 latency improved from 2.5s to 1.0s, error rate trending down.
Jordan (Acme): Smoke completed — 15m at 200rps with concurrency cap; saw 3 429s early then none. Much better. Demo team wants a <0.8s p95 if possible.
Nate: Longer-term perf tune: tune kernel batching, enable prefix caching and shorten kv eviction TTL. That's more invasive; plan overnight and canary first.
Ara: Security note: customer uploaded a security questionnaire. Two outstanding items: (1) data retention for logs during POC; (2) confirm encryption at rest for dedicated option. Jordan, can you confirm PII in test payloads?
Jordan (Acme): We'll scrub PII for tests. For exec demo they might show synthetic examples. Regarding encryption, we'd need a written confirmation.
Lee: For pricing, we can offer a month trial credit and a one-time pilot discount if they sign LOI within 30 days. I'll prepare options — not blocking the demo.
Jamie: Summary/action items — Sam to keep override thru demo (SAM), Nate to run kernel canary overnight and post traces (NATE), Maya to validate logs and rerun smoke 30m before demo (MAYA), Ara to draft security attestation for encryption + retention (ARA), Jordan to run final verification 45m pre-demo (JORDAN). Anyone add?
Maya: I'll post the smoke results and any anomalies to this thread. If we see regressions we revert the override immediately.
Jordan (Acme): Thanks team — appreciate the rapid support :clap:
oncall-bot: INC-900 update: override active, monitors green. Next update in 20m.
